text: Okay, fine. Like I said, I don't have my email. My name is Yusuf Rossi. My zip code is 19122. Can you get my account with that? I need to return the stuff. And I still need to know how many t-shirts are available.
zh: 好的，行。就像我说的，我没有电子邮件。我的名字是Yusuf Rossi。我的邮政编码是19122。你能用这些信息找到我的账户吗？我需要退货。我仍然需要知道有多少T恤可选。
